semantics.admission: Commit the exact producer admission without sending a target command. Return original stored admission on duplicate.
semantics.invocation: Require original actionRef, snapshotRef, input, scope, approval and idempotency key. Never create a new admission. Claim the original attempt durably before target I/O.
semantics.uncertainOutcome: Retain original identity and uncertainty. Status reads may reconcile but cannot dispatch.
semantics.authority: Dispatcher credential does not replace scoped Agent authentication, producer grant, Human approval or target checks.
semantics.recovery: A replacement process or snapshot does not restore permission to dispatch an old admission.
semantics.credentials: Host-configured dispatcher secret is distinct from Agent and Studio credentials. Never expose it to a browser or model. Both transport credentials are required.
semantics.errors: Non-success HTTP responses use the existing Gateway error object with bounded error code and message; they do not certify whether a previously submitted action occurred.
